entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Perf regression: mvc #66730
  • API proposal: Allow OpenAPI registration to resolve document names upon request #66725
  • Make CRLF required in line terminator in the chunked trailer section in Kestrel's `ParseChunkedTrailer` -> `HttpParser.TryParseHeaders` #66724
  • `CacheTagHelper`: `MemoryCacheEntryOptions.Size` omits `vary-by` key memory #66723
  • ResponseCaching/OutputCaching: incorrect cache key computation for multi-value Vary headers #66721
  • Improve IsChunked parsing/handling #66720
  • Improve documentation on parallel streaming invocations limit #66719
  • Improve documentation on role or user change during SignalR connection lifetime #66718

Closed

  • Perf improvement: json, json #66714
  • Perf regression: json_middleware #66677
  • Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi generates incorrect nullable enum #66295
  • [OpenAPI] Default CreateSchemaReferenceId produces invalid schema keys for array types #66299
    11.0-preview5
  • RedirectHttpResult does not emit 302 OpenAPI response metadata for Minimal APIs #66682
  • [Blazor] Data annotations localization support #12158
    11.0-preview5
  • Create server rendered forms with client validation using Blazor without a circuit #51040
    11.0-preview5
  • DefaultProblemDetailsWriter doesn't pass cancellation token to WriteAsJsonAsync #66600
    11.0-preview5
  • Static Assets + Blazor + JS import fails with integrity error on Azure #66612
  • Localization support for Microsoft.Extensions.Validation #65539
    .NET 11 Planning

PullRequests

Created

  • Replace Blazor WebAssembly DevServer with Gateway in templates #66729
    area-blazor
  • Validation: skip static properties in generated model traversal #66728
    needs-area-label
  • Fix possible deadlock in UnixCertificateManager and MacOSCertificateManager #66727
    needs-area-label
  • [release/10.0] Fix null reference error in Virtualize component #66726
    Servicing-consider, area-blazor
  • Update issue triage agent to use issue type instead of labels #66722
    area-infrastructure

Merged

  • Bump Wasm.Performance benchmark to Node.js 22 #66686
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview5
  • [release/10.0] [Blazor] `OwningComponentBase` Dispose method in .NET 10 gets back the original behavior #64794
    Servicing-approved, area-blazor, 10.0.9
  • Add special handling for array types in OpenAPI schema references. #66583
    feature-openapi, area-minimal, 11.0-preview5
  • Add localization support to Microsoft.Extensions.Validation #66646
    area-infrastructure, 11.0-preview5
  • Pass RequestAborted cancellation token to WriteAsJsonAsync in DefaultProblemDetailsWriter #66606
    area-networking, 11.0-preview5

Updated

  • Identity: Use TimeProvider for Passkey CreatedAt #66569
    area-identity, community-contribution
  • Fix ValidationsGenerator ITypeParameterSymbol handling #65419
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-minimal, feature-validation
  • feat(blazor): add CssClass parameter to ValidationSummary component #66531
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • RenderFragment serialization #66528
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview5
  • Make dotnet-user-secrets Native AOT compatible #66663
    area-commandlinetools
  • Fix ValidationsGenerator CS8785 when AddValidation is called from multiple sites #66675
    area-mvc, area-blazor, feature-validation
  • Use SDK Asset Groups for Assets.Internal and Identity UI #66412
    area-identity
  • Add HttpSys wrapper interface for HttpQueryRequestProperty Windows API #66700
    area-networking
  • Fix KeyRingProvider thread pool starvation on cold start #66683
    area-dataprotection
  • Add `ConfigureHostApplicationBuilder` virtual method on WebApplicationFactory to allow early configuration of the host application builder #66527
    area-mvc
  • Allow OpenAPI registration to resolve document names upon request #66692
    needs-area-label
  • Use publicly available version of ServiceDiscovery package in blazor-wasm-servicedefaults template #66698
    area-mvc
  • Added Culture persistence between Client and Server #63144
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview5
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #66676
